newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-PARAGUAY CAPTAIN CHILAVERT SLAPS REPORTER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARAGUAY CAPTAIN CHILAVERT SLAPS REPORTER.

text.p: Paraguay captain Jose Luis Chilavert on Friday slapped a sports reporter who wrote that he had put on weight during his holidays, the Argentine state news agency Telam said.

Juan Pablo Mendez of the sports daily Ole approached goalkeeper Chilavert after practice at the player's Argentine club Velez Sarsfield and was on the receiving end of an outburst from the Paraguayan national hero.
Telam said Chilavert was angered by the reporter's story suggesting he looked heavier on his return from vacation and slapped him.
The player punched a stadium assistant on the head in a game between Velez Sarsfield and Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata in April 1994.
Chilavert, a menacing figure in goal who wears a bulldog design on his chest, says he wants to become president of Paraguay one day and impose his own brand of law and order.
